feedback: Written before this candidate has raced, so no outcome is claimed for it. Iteration 9 (entityR2B, 111.80) confirms the wheel_track 0.12 platform with slalom line loss 0.10, so the baseline is reliable. Iterations 6 to 8 (entityR2B, 72.91, 79.60, 77.55) show that wheel_track 0.10 is worse at every kp tried (2.5, 2.75, 3.0): oval progress fell from 0.55 to 0.28 to 0.30, and slalom line loss was 0.35 at kp 3.0. So keep 0.12. Iteration 4 (entityR2B, 124.20) shows that lower inertia gave the best progress, oval 0.53 and s-bend 0.20, but slalom line loss of 0.85. The midpoint you proposed (mass 0.75, body_length 0.16) is the next inertia step, and the race decides the next move. max_error has stayed at 0.061 to 0.066 m across all nine races, so do not treat it as a tuning target. The run-ending threshold is the more likely cause.
requested_changes: Keep wheel_track 0.12 and the 0.06 m sensor span with 16 mm footprints. Do not return to wheel_track 0.10 (iterations 6 to 8).
If slalom line_loss_events is 0.2 or higher after this race, revert to mass 0.8 and body_length 0.18 and stop reducing inertia, since iteration 4 showed 0.85 at lower inertia.
If slalom line loss is 0.1 or below, do not go lower on inertia. Next test a controller-only change, such as a small base_speed increase, so that progress rises without changing the platform again.
